envelope.description: Backfill rule: preview and ISSUE write

body.title: Backfill rule: preview and ISSUE write
body.summary: Add the repair rule and step 'backfill-issue' before 'units': the preview lists one change per standalone trivial BUILD with no DEF, ISSUE or LLD head; repair writes a kind 'change' ISSUE under the BUILD's hash from its focus, triage rationale and summary, anchored at its epicCreatedAt, approved by the migration actor with the reason recorded, or left pending when the BUILD is not approved. Each write is reported under 'backfill-issue'.
acceptanceChecks: repair-preview lists one backfill-issue change per headless BUILD and writes nothing.
repair writes the ISSUEs; a second run lists none.
The ISSUE of a BUILD that is not approved stays pending.

tests.name: repair-preview lists one backfill-issue change per headless standalone trivial BUILD and writes nothing
repair writes a kind change ISSUE for each headless BUILD, approved by the migration actor, and a second repair lists none
